bio.text: Mark Baisley is a Republican state senator representing Colorado's Senate District 4 and is the Republican Party candidate for U.S. Senate in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he was elected to the Colorado House of Representatives in 2018 and to the state Senate in 2022.

The legislature lists his occupation as aerospace engineer; his campaign site says he earned a bachelor's degree at Columbia College and worked for Martin Marietta, Hughes, Raytheon and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory before leading a Colorado software company.
